# DataForSEO Backlinks Domain Pages Summary API

Backlink metrics for each page of a domain: backlinks, referring domains and rank per page.

Request fields follow the official DataForSEO `/v3/backlinks/domain_pages_summary/live` task schema (one task per call). The response is DataForSEO's original JSON; results are in `tasks[].result`.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/dataforseo/v3/backlinks/domain_pages_summary/live" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"target": "nike.com", "limit": 10}'
```

## Parameters

The JSON body is forwarded to the upstream endpoint. Main fields:

| Name | Description |
|---|---|
| `target` | Domain or subdomain, e.g. "nike.com". |
| `limit` | Maximum number of pages to return. |

## Reference

- Official docs: https://docs.dataforseo.com/v3/backlinks/domain_pages_summary/live/

## Pricing

Billed at the actual cost of each call, about $0.02436 for the request above. The cost grows with the number of rows, targets or tokens a call returns. Failed calls are not charged. Searches with no results are billed at their actual cost.
